status: Five prepared drafts; no publication dates approved.

publication.date_meaning: Manuscript creation date only. Existing publication calendars are unchanged.

editorial_scope: Accepted Rust editorial follow-ups. Three database boundary investigations, one build investigation, one native deployment guide. Disconnect testing is part of the commit article.
verification: GitHub Content safety only. See the pull request for the checked revision and CI artifacts.
limitations: The streaming fixture simulates a slow consumer with a channel; no HTTP integration, RSS measurement or server socket wait assertion.
The commit relay uses plaintext loopback PostgreSQL in a disposable database. No host crash, failover, storage durability or remote side-effect guarantee.
SQLx metadata trial uses live macro compilation and metadata comparison, not sqlx-cli prepare --check.
Oracle CI covers compilation and missing-client failure only. Successful client loading and Oracle Database integration require the actual deployment environment.

articles.title: Is Your Rust Request Waiting for a Connection or for PostgreSQL?
articles.distinct_contribution: Application, connection-pool and row-lock waits are arranged and observed separately.

articles.title: PostgreSQL Committed, but the Rust Caller Lost the Reply
articles.distinct_contribution: A protocol relay suppresses COMMIT CommandComplete; independent reads check atomic state and replay. Includes pre-commit termination.

articles.title: A Slow PostgreSQL Row Consumer Keeps a Rust Connection Busy
articles.distinct_contribution: A controlled consumer pause checks connection retention, collection and cancellation. No HTTP, RSS or wire-buffer measurement.

articles.title: A SQLx Offline Build Can Pass With Stale Database Metadata
articles.distinct_contribution: An integer-to-bigint migration separates stale offline success, runtime decode failure and live compile failure.

articles.title: Your Rust Binary Built, but Oracle Client Is Missing in Deployment
articles.distinct_contribution: Client-only loading probe. CI negative path requires DPI-1047; successful native loading and Oracle server integration remain unverified.
